description.en: Sets the player's passion points, or adds to them when the second argument is true. Passion points are a currency kept with the party data (0 to 9,999,999). In add mode the result is kept between 0 and 9,999,999; a plain set stores the value as given.
New value, or amount to add (negative to remove).
true to add instead of set.

true.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: The rest area (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_heal.nut)
Giving 100 passion points (real usage, from ev42021000.nut)
